title: Team contract: revise for Toolkit Migration and collect re-confirmation
body: Contract revised for the confirmed project and roles. All five members confirm the October revision; fill in the agreement date on the signature page before submission.

title: Client meeting prep document (Oct 8)
body: One page: client, problem as understood, questions on actionable problem, context, data and NDA, success by December, progress update timing, final presentation logistics.

title: Project scope Version 1 sent to IF
body: PMI style scope statement, sent to IF on Oct 6 with the Oct 8 meeting invitation (docs/scope.tex). Confirm with Joshua whether IF approved Version 1; Version 2 supersedes it.

title: Set up GitHub repository and project board
body: Private repository and this board, created by scripts/publish.sh.

title: Client meeting Oct 8: access, Claude consent, scope, success measures
body: Confirm with Joshua: meeting held, decisions recorded. Was: access, Claude consent, scope, success measures.

title: Send meeting notes and follow up email to IF
body: Confirm with Joshua that the Oct 8 notes went to IF.

title: Scope Version 2 with Oct 8 decisions
body: Confirm with Like whether Version 2 went to IF, and with what decisions.

title: Collect decisions due Oct 16 (freeze date, old web address, owner after December, NDA)
body: Confirm with Joshua which decisions IF has made (freeze date, old web address, owner after December, NDA).

title: Local WordPress practice site
body: Local WordPress with SQLite used for the integration tests (eval/results/wordpress_integration.txt); Docker setup in wordpress/.

title: Toolkit inventory: crawl_toolkit and fetch_page tools
body: Built in src/cdp_migration/tools/inventory.py. Reads the five module pages and each page's embedded Wix record. Team to review; live run pending.

title: Activity schema and validate_activity tool
body: Built: src/cdp_migration/schema.py and tools/extract.py; JSON schema in the skill folder. Team to review.

title: Activity layout proposal to IF (post type, fields, template)
body: Plugin built: wordpress/cdp-activity/ (post type, filters, Activity details box, draft only role, embed host list, uninstall). Needs IF website manager approval and a Breakdance template.

title: Test data and evaluation set
body: Synthetic Toolkit checked against the live structure (eval/live_structure_2026-11-01.json) and planted problem cases. Live comparison via cdp evaluate --live.

title: Run the migration on the live Toolkit (cdp evaluate --live)
body: Needs IF consent first if Claude is used (cdp migrate itself uses no AI). On a computer that can reach collaborativediscussionproject.com: pip install -e . then cdp evaluate --live.

title: Install the plugin on IF staging and create the drafter account
body: Needs IF website manager approval. Steps in wordpress/README.md.

title: Send the Claude consent request to IF
body: docs/consent_request.pdf. Attach Anthropic's current API data policy summary.

title: extract_activity and check_fidelity tools
body: Built and tested: deterministic mapping from the Wix record; count aware verbatim check with word level diffs.

title: scan_pii and check_links tools
body: Built and tested: emails, phones, commenter names, instruction like text; link checks and Redirection CSV.

title: rehost_asset tool
body: Built and tested, including against a local WordPress 6.5 site.

title: create_draft tool with draft only WordPress role
body: Built; WordPress refused a publish attempt by the drafter account in the integration test.

title: Orchestrator, extraction, and reviewer agents
body: Built: own tool-use loop on the Claude Messages API, one session per activity, limits enforced. Tested with scripted model turns; first real run needs an API key.

title: Pilot: 5 activities migrated to the practice site
body: End to end run on about 5 activities across modules; first evaluation numbers.

title: Progress update meeting with IF (mid November, date to confirm)
body: Pilot results, first evaluation, Claude cost estimate. Like prepares the progress document.

title: All 46 activities on the practice site
body: Full migration run; every page passes checks or is routed to human review.

title: Guardrails with versus without evaluation
body: Offline ablation done (eval/results/offline_eval.md). Agent arms need ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: cdp agent-eval and cdp extraction-eval.

title: Skill folder: SKILL.md, templates, examples, review checklist
body: Built: skills/toolkit-activity-publisher/. Team to review wording with IF.

title: IF staff usability test of the update workflow
body: Staff member creates a ready to review activity draft; target 15 minutes or less.

title: Publicity write up draft sent to IF for approval
body: Short article for IF's newsletter and social media; Joshua emails it to IF.

title: Final evaluation report, link list, staff guides
body: Evaluation results, redirect list, one page maintenance guide, staff how to guide, known limitations.

title: Final presentation, training, and handover (Dec 3)
body: Presentation, live training, transfer of code and accounts to IF.

title: Client status email every two weeks
body: Recurring: progress, next steps, open questions. Confirm with Joshua that the Oct 23 email went out. Next dates: Nov 6, Nov 20.
